entity_name: Ministry of Public Works and Transport (وزارة الأشغال العامة والنقل)

facts.value: PRIMARY entity for maintenance and management of Lebanon's national roads, highways, and autostrads.
facts.notes: LLM-RT-002 confirms MPWT (not CDR) is primary for autostrad/highway issues. CDR is primary ONLY when inside an active CDR worksite.

facts.value: Oversees public transportation infrastructure, seaports, airports (coordination), and public works projects not assigned to CDR. Also responsible for urban planning coordination (General Directorate of Urban Planning) and land & maritime transport licensing.

Five administrative units confirmed from official site: (1) Shared Administrative Directorate (المديرية الإدارية المشتركة) — accounting and legal affairs. (2) General Directorate of Roads & Buildings (المديرية العامة للطرق و المباني) — the unit responsible for national road maintenance, with sub-units: Roads Directorate (Construction, Design & Programming, Studies, Maintenance departments) and Buildings Directorate. Also has Regional Directorates (المديريات الإقليمية). (3) General Directorate of Urban Planning (المديرية العامة للتنظيم المدني). (4) General Directorate of Land & Maritime Transport (المديرية العامة للنقل البري و البحري). (5) General Directorate of Civil Aviation (المديرية العامة للطيران المدني). For CedarFix road complaints: the relevant unit is General Directorate of Roads & Buildings → Roads Directorate → Maintenance Department (مصلحة الصيانة).
facts.notes: Administrative units confirmed from mopw.gov.lb/الوحدات-الإدارية-(1) on 2026-05-31. Previous fact had incorrect count of 4 directorates.

facts.value: National road network (autostrads, highways, national roads) across all Lebanese governorates. Does NOT cover local/municipal streets — those are municipality responsibility. Regional Directorates (المديريات الإقليمية) exist under the General Directorate of Roads & Buildings for regional coverage, but specific regional office contacts not yet published on website.

Website: mopw.gov.lb. Phone: +(961) 5 455821 / +(961) 5 455822 (two lines). Email: ministry@mopw.gov.lb. Minister (2026): Fayez Rasamny. Social media: Twitter, Facebook. No dedicated citizen complaint hotline exists — all road complaints go to the main ministry number. No online complaint form exists on mopw.gov.lb.
facts.notes: Contacts confirmed from Arabic version footer at mopw.gov.lb on 2026-05-31. English version showed different numbers (459980, mail@ministry.gov.lb) — Arabic footer is authoritative. No citizen complaint form or hotline exists on the site.

facts.value: No officially published SLA for national road repair. CedarFix target varies by severity: emergency (downed bridge, collapsed road) 24-48h, non-emergency (pothole, crack) 72h-2 weeks.

Boundary between MPWT and CDR jurisdiction for road projects can be ambiguous: CDR executes infrastructure on behalf of GoL but MPWT has ongoing maintenance. Active CDR project = CDR primary; maintenance after project closure = MPWT.
facts.human_review_reason: MPWT vs CDR boundary requires case-by-case assessment for any road that may be part of a CDR project.

facts.value: No dedicated citizen complaint channel exists. Complaint process: (1) Call main ministry lines: 05/455821 or 05/455822. (2) Email: ministry@mopw.gov.lb. (3) Visit General Directorate of Roads & Buildings directly and reach the Maintenance Department (مصلحة الصيانة). No online form, no WhatsApp channel, no dedicated road complaint hotline confirmed on mopw.gov.lb as of 2026-05-31. HITL always required before any MPWT routing — citizen must be directed to call the ministry directly.
facts.notes: Confirmed absence of citizen complaint form from full review of mopw.gov.lb Arabic version on 2026-05-31. Arabic site has more content than English version.

primary_for_sectors: ROADS_national — autostrads, highways, national roads (not local streets)
ROADS_bridge — bridge damage or collapse on national network
secondary_for_sectors: ROADS_local — escalation when municipality is unclear or unresponsive
ROADS_construction — if not an active CDR worksite
not_responsible_for: Active CDR project worksites — route to CDR
Electricity on roads — route to EDL
Water under roads — route to relevant water establishment
